message:
The robot stays inside the mass and box limits with build margin because the full stack with stiffened frame still weighs well under the cap and stows with clearance. Manager, the updated mass sum with stiffened frame against 60 kg limit (E62) is 46.0 kg versus 60.0 kg with 14.0 kg margin in the mass margin check (E67), about one airline bag spare on a small-adult-weight machine, and the stowed size in the tip dump clearance check (E51) is 0.900 by 0.420 by 0.450 m inside 1.00 by 0.500 by 0.500 m.

Power reaches every load from two identified deck packs with no break in the chain because the fused bus feeds drive, ladder, tilt screw and compute from a shared 24 V pack. Excavation and Regolith Handling Lead and Autonomy and Blind Operations Lead, the ladder power from cut force (E59) is 16.4 W and the dig energy per trip (E60) is 0.512 Wh per 15.0 kg trip versus 480 Wh in the LiFePO4 pack, meaning lithium iron phosphate, in the battery pack concept (C24), like a night-light load on a household battery that allows dozens of trips.

The chassis carries ladder, hopper and wheel arms without soft bending because the twin-tube frame was stiffened after the first sag fail. Mobility and Deployable Chassis Lead, the stiffened twin-rail tip sag (E63) is 3.96 mm versus 72.9 mm in the cantilever deflection estimate (E43), about a coin thickness over a metre rail, so mounts stay aligned for kerf chain, ladder chute and hopper pivots.

Position: ready, because mass, stowed envelope, continuous fused power with energy margin, and millimetre stiffness all survive and the missing pack labels and arm brackets change no fixed part or connection.
